text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick update — starting immediately (effective 2026-04-06) we’re tightening international travel admin to speed reimbursements and improve traveler safety. Key points: 1) All international trips require pre-approval via the Travel Request form before booking (link below). 2) Upload all receipts to TravelCred within 15 days after trip end — no paper exceptions. 3) Per-diem clarification: EMEA meals up to $75/day, APAC $85/day; still upload receipts for transport items > $50. 4) Complete the Travel Safety Attestation 24–72 hours before departure (emergency contacts, local regs, insurance). 5) Code of Conduct reminder for external meetings — treat client spaces as extensions of the office. Non-compliance can delay reimbursements or trigger HR follow-up. Links: https://confluence.redwood/travel-policy and Travel Request form: https://travel.redwood/request :spiral_calendar_pad: :passport_control:

Samir Patel: Thanks Maya — quick Q: is this retroactive for trips already booked for May? I booked before the memo.

Maya (People Ops): Good q. If your travel start date is before 2026-04-06, follow the old process (you have 30 days to submit receipts). For trips starting on/after 2026-04-06, please use the new flow. If you already booked and need an exception (vendor constraints, visas), DM me and we’ll mark it as exception.

Jules Tran: Where’s an example of a correctly filled Travel Request? I want to make sure project codes are right.

Maya (People Ops): Template here: https://confluence.redwood/travel-templates — fill out approver (team lead) + estimated costs. Note: finance will auto-review for policy breaches.

Ava (Finance): Heads-up — make sure to include the project code field in TravelCred or expenses will be queued for manual tagging. Pro tip: use the TravelCred mobile app to scan receipts (jpg/pdf) — it OCRs totals and date.

Jules Tran: Any changes to per-diem for long trips (>14 days)?

Maya (People Ops): Long-trip adjustments can be requested in the Travel Request (there’s a checkbox). Finance will review; include a short justification.

ExpenseBot: Automated reminder — you have 3 trips with missing receipts older than 7 days. Upload them here: https://travel.redwood/claims (auto-notify to finance) :bell:

Travel-Safety-Bot: Reminder — complete the Safety Attestation at least 24 hours before departure. Emergency numbers and insurer contact are on Confluence. If traveling to high-risk regions, contact security for an escort plan.

Samir Patel: Thanks, all. Do we have mandatory training for travelers?

Maya (People Ops): For frequent travelers (>=6 international trips/year) we now require the 20-min Travel Safety micro-course once per 12 months — we’ll roll it out in Lattice next week. Q&A: Friday 10am in #all-hands or join the 30-min drop-in (calendar invite sent). :calendar: :thumbsup:

Ava (Finance): If anyone wants help migrating receipts from older trips into TravelCred, ping #finance and we’ll assist.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks — looping in Finance & Security. Please read the Confluence doc before booking. If you hit edge cases, DM me or open a ticket at people-ops@redwood.com.
